title: TraceEvent
description: One line of trace.jsonl. Append-only, monotonic seq per run. Every event is independently parseable; a truncated file is still usable.

seq.description: Globally monotonic within a run. Referenced by symptom evidence and fault fires.

ts_mono_ms.description: Milliseconds since run start. Use this for durations; ts is for humans.

level.description: Lowest trace_level at which this event is emitted.

name.description: Tool / node / llm alias / state key this event concerns.

payload.description: Event-specific body. Large values are replaced by a truncation stub: {"__truncated__": true, "bytes": N, "sha256": "…", "head": "…"}. Redaction is applied before writing.

$comment: Payload contracts per kind (enforced by tests, not by this schema): run_started {seed, plan_hash, scenario_id, limits, target}; tool_call_requested {args, kwargs}; tool_call_returned {result, ok}; tool_call_failed {error_type, message}; llm_request {messages, model, estimated_tokens}; llm_response {content, tool_calls, finish_reason, tokens}; fault_armed {type, params, target, trigger}; fault_fired {type, action, note, delay_ms}; fault_skipped {type, reason}; mutation_applied {payload_before, payload_after, json_patch, unrepresentable}; state_snapshot {state}; state_mutated {keys, json_patch}; edge_taken {from, to, forced}; probe_fired {code, severity, detail, evidence}; limit_exceeded {limit, value}; judge_request {prompt_hash, model, evidence_bytes}; judge_response {raw, latency_ms, tokens}; judge_verdict {verdict}; internal_error {where, type, message, traceback}; assertion_result {check, ok, detail, source, params, evidence} - also the event emitted by engine.validated(), with check="validation"; log {message, kind?} - carries spec_gap, replay_divergence and engine.note() breadcrumbs. This enum is normative: the illustrative list in docs/01-ARCHITECTURE.md section 4 is not (D-35). A state_mutated patch carries a real RFC-6902 patch or the documented truncation stub, never a prose summary.
